answer.book: A printed academic disputation (Bremen, 1613) in which respondent Ludovicus Crocius argues against Catholic claims about the universality of the church: a title page, then numbered theses, followed by conclusions with their arguments and solutions of authorities.

entries.title: Disputationum theologicarum secunda, de universalitate ecclesiæ
Conclusio quarta. Hæretici sunt qui a certis dogmatum auctoribus nomina trahunt.
